risk_if_not_implemented: Without Emergency Lighting, unauthorized individuals may gain physical access to facilities and equipment, enabling theft, tampering, damage or safety incidents. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Injury / Loss of Life (R-SF-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; man-made threats MT-6, MT-7, MT-9, MT-10, MT-21, MT-27.

compensating_control_1.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Emergency Lighting (PES-23) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS)
compensating_control_2.description:
Mechanisms exist to operate a Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) to achieve resilient Technology Assets, Applications, Services and/or Data (TAASD) during:
(1) Routine operations; and
(2) Adverse conditions.
compensating_control_2.justification: Business Continuity Management System (BCMS) (BCD-02) provides resilience and recovery capability that compensates for the absence of Emergency Lighting (PES-23) by ensuring the organization can restore operations and data when the primary control is absent. Given the facility and physical environment focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
